In CCLE, how similar are the sensitivity profiles of breast cancer cell lines to Lapatinib and Neratinib? Compare their responses in shared cell lines, calculate the Spearman correlation, and identify the five cell lines with the most discordant sensitivity rankings. Visualize the results.

In GDSC2, do colorectal cancer cell lines that are sensitive to SN-38 also tend to be sensitive to Oxaliplatin? Compare responses among cell lines tested with both drugs, calculate the correlation, and identify models showing sensitivity to one drug but resistance to the other.

In GDSC2, compare Erlotinib and Gefitinib sensitivity among lung cancer cell lines. Are their responses correlated, and does the relationship differ between EGFR-mutant and EGFR-wild-type models? Report the effect sizes and visualize the paired responses.

Using PRISM, identify the five drugs showing the strongest preferential sensitivity in breast cancer cell lines compared with cell lines from other tissues. Account for differences in sample size, correct for multiple testing, and determine whether any of the identified drugs show a similar breast-selective response in CTRPv2.

In NCI60, how similar are the sensitivity profiles of Paclitaxel and Doxorubicin? Compare cell lines tested with both drugs using within-drug response rankings. Identify cell lines that are particularly sensitive to one drug but resistant to the other, and examine their dose-response curves.

In the HMCL PSet, compare the sensitivity of multiple myeloma cell lines to Bortezomib and Carfilzomib. Among cell lines tested with both drugs, calculate their response correlation, identify discordant models, and determine whether the observed differences are supported by their raw dose-response curves.

In gCSI, which five drugs show the greatest variability in sensitivity across breast cancer cell lines? Rank drugs by the interquartile range of their response measurements, restricting the analysis to drugs tested in at least 20 cell lines. Determine whether the rankings change after excluding poor-quality dose-response curves, and visualize the response distribution for the leading drug.

In CCLE, does Paclitaxel sensitivity differ significantly across cancer tissue types? Restrict the analysis to tissues with at least ten tested cell lines, compare response distributions, correct for multiple comparisons, and identify which tissues are significantly more sensitive or resistant.

In CCLE melanoma cell lines, how similar are the sensitivity profiles of PLX4720 and PD-0325901? Compare responses in shared cell lines, calculate their correlation, and identify melanoma models with divergent responses.

In GDSC2, identify the five drugs showing the greatest variability in sensitivity across breast cancer cell lines. For each drug, compare the most sensitive and most resistant cell lines, then determine whether the observed sensitivity ranking is reproduced in CTRPv2 for models tested with the same drug.

In GDSC2, how similar are the sensitivity profiles of hematologic cancer cell lines to Venetoclax and Navitoclax? Compare their responses in shared cell lines, calculate the Spearman correlation, and identify the five cell lines with the most discordant sensitivity rankings. Visualize the results.

In gCSI, does the relationship between Gemcitabine and Doxorubicin sensitivity vary across cancer tissue types? Compare responses in cell lines tested with both drugs, calculate the overall correlation and tissue-specific correlations where sample sizes are sufficient, and identify tissues with the most divergent response patterns.

In CTRPv2, how similar are the sensitivity profiles of Irinotecan, SN-38, and Topotecan? Identify cell lines tested with all three drugs, calculate pairwise correlations using within-drug sensitivity rankings, and identify models that are sensitive to one inhibitor but resistant to the others. Visualize the relationships.

Using PRISM, identify the ten drugs showing the greatest preferential sensitivity in hematologic cancer cell lines compared with solid-tumor cell lines. Account for differences in sample size and correct for multiple testing. Determine whether the leading associations are reproduced in gCSI for drugs tested in both datasets.

In gCSI, are ovarian cancer cell lines sensitive to Olaparib also sensitive to Cisplatin? Compare their sensitivity rankings among shared cell lines, calculate the Spearman correlation, and identify models with high sensitivity to Olaparib but low sensitivity to Cisplatin, and vice versa.

In NCI60, do cell lines with similar drug-response profiles tend to originate from the same cancer tissue? Select the 20 drugs tested in the greatest number of cell lines, construct a standardized drug-sensitivity matrix, perform hierarchical clustering, and determine whether the resulting clusters are enriched for particular cancer tissue types. Visualise the results as a heatmap.

In the HMCL multiple myeloma PSet, are there drugs that show preferential activity in Bortezomib-resistant cell lines? Define resistant and sensitive groups using the upper and lower quartiles of Bortezomib sensitivity, respectively. Compare responses to other drugs between the groups, correct for multiple testing, and identify the five compounds showing the strongest preferential sensitivity in Bortezomib-resistant models.

In gCSI, which drug pairs have the most similar and most opposing sensitivity profiles across cancer cell lines? Restrict the analysis to drug pairs tested in at least 200 shared cell lines, calculate tissue-adjusted response associations, and identify the ten pairs with the strongest positive and negative associations. Visualise the relationships using a clustered correlation heatmap.

Among hematologic cancer cell lines in GDSC2, is higher BCL2 RNA expression associated with greater sensitivity to Venetoclax? Perform an association analysis, report the effect size and statistical significance, and determine whether the association remains after excluding the most sensitive cell line.

In CCLE, compare the associations of NQO1, HSP90AA1, and HSP90AB1 RNA expression with sensitivity to 17-AAG. Which gene shows the strongest association after adjusting for tissue type? Determine whether the leading association is also observed in CTRPv2.

Among CCLE breast cancer cell lines, do ERBB2 RNA expression and ERBB2 copy number independently predict Lapatinib sensitivity? Compare their individual associations and fit a joint model to determine whether either molecular feature provides additional predictive information beyond the other.

Across eligible ORCESTRA cell-line PSets, investigate whether ABCB1 RNA expression is associated with resistance to Paclitaxel. Estimate tissue-adjusted associations within each dataset, compare their direction and magnitude, and determine whether the relationship is reproducible across independent drug-response screens.

In GDSC2 melanoma cell lines, is BRAF V600E mutation status associated with sensitivity to Dabrafenib and Trametinib? Compare the magnitude and statistical significance of the associations for the two drugs, and visualize the sensitivity distributions of mutant and wild-type cell lines.

In GDSC2 lung cancer cell lines, are EGFR RNA expression and EGFR mutation status independently associated with Erlotinib sensitivity? Compare models using each molecular feature separately and together, and determine whether expression remains informative after accounting for mutation status.

In gCSI, test whether TP53 mutation status is associated with sensitivity to Nutlin-3a. Compare the unadjusted association with a tissue-adjusted analysis, quantify the difference in effect estimates, and determine whether the result is driven by a particular tissue type.

In GDSC2, does BRAF V600E status predict a different magnitude of response to a BRAF inhibitor in melanoma compared with colorectal cancer? Analyze the two tissues separately, compare effect sizes, and test whether the mutation-response association differs between the tissues.

In CCLE, determine whether the association between BRAF mutation status and PD-0325901 sensitivity is stronger when restricting the analysis to melanoma cell lines than when analyzing all tissues together. Compare effect sizes, statistical significance, and sample sizes, and assess the influence of tissue adjustment.

In CCLE, identify the genes most strongly associated with PD-0325901 sensitivity using RNA expression profiles. Repeat the analysis in melanoma cell lines only. Which associations remain consistent in direction and rank, and which appear to depend on the tissue composition of the original analysis?

Across eligible ORCESTRA PSets, compare the relationships between BCL2, BCL2L1, and MCL1 RNA expression and sensitivity to Venetoclax versus Navitoclax. Are the molecular associations different between the two drugs after accounting for cancer tissue and ensuring that the compounds are not treated as synonyms?

In GDSC2_matrix, which cancer cell lines show the strongest synergy between AZD6738 and Capivasertib? Identify the five most synergistic and five least synergistic cell lines based on Bliss scores, compare their HSA scores, and determine whether the two synergy models produce consistent cell-line rankings. Visualize the results.

In NCI_ALMANAC, which drugs show the strongest synergy when combined with Valrubicin in renal cancer cell lines? Rank the ten most synergistic combinations based on their median Bliss scores and consistency across cell lines. Determine whether the leading combinations also show synergy in other cancer tissues.

In GDSC2_matrix, which drug combinations show positive Bliss synergy but little or no HSA synergy in at least five cell lines? Identify the ten combinations with the greatest disagreement between the two metrics, determine whether these discrepancies are consistent across cancer tissues, and visualize the relationship between Bliss and HSA scores.

In GDSC2_matrix, is synergy between AZD5153 and Selumetinib associated with sensitivity to either drug individually? Compare the combination's Bliss synergy scores with the monotherapy sensitivity measurements across cell lines, calculate the associations, and determine whether they persist after adjusting for cancer tissue.

In the GDSC-SQUARE Anchor screen, which drug combinations produce the greatest improvements in both potency and maximum efficacy? Identify the ten combinations with the strongest consistent improvements across cell lines, compare their potency and efficacy changes, and determine whether their effects differ across cancer tissue types.

In NCI_ALMANAC, does the combination of Bortezomib and Vandetanib show tissue-specific synergy? Compare its Bliss synergy scores across cancer tissues, identify the most responsive tissue groups, and determine whether the observed synergy is associated with sensitivity to either individual drug.

Across eligible ORCESTRA molecular profiles and GDSC2_matrix combination responses, is BCL2 RNA expression associated with Bliss synergy between Olaparib and Venetoclax? Evaluate the association across matched cell lines, account for tissue type, and determine whether BCL2 expression provides information beyond sensitivity to either drug alone.

In NCI_ALMANAC, which ten drug combinations show the most reproducible Bliss synergy across cancer cell lines? Rank combinations using both median synergy and the proportion of tested cell lines showing positive synergy. Determine how stable these rankings are when individual cancer tissue groups are excluded.

Use the available potency-change measurements together with the MSI/MSS annotations from Supplementary Table 2, perform the statistical comparison, and recreate the figure.

Identify combinations with at least five shared tested cell lines, calculate cross-dataset correlations, and determine which combinations show the greatest agreement and disagreement. Visualize the relationships.

How reproducible is Lapatinib sensitivity across CCLE, CTRPv2, and gCSI? Identify shared cell lines, calculate pairwise Spearman correlations using comparable response endpoints, and generate a cross-dataset sensitivity heatmap. Determine which cell lines exhibit the greatest disagreement across the three screens.

Across ORCESTRA PSets containing both Paclitaxel sensitivity measurements and RNA expression profiles, which genes show reproducible associations with drug response? Perform tissue-adjusted association analyses separately in each eligible dataset, identify genes with concordant effect directions and significant FDR values in at least two independent screens, and rank the ten most reproducible associations.

Across eligible ORCESTRA lung cancer cell-line PSets, is EGFR mutation status consistently associated with Erlotinib sensitivity? Estimate the mutation-associated effect within each dataset, compare effect directions and magnitudes, and calculate a pooled association estimate with a measure of between-dataset heterogeneity.

Among BRAF V600E-mutant melanoma cell lines, which BRAF or MEK inhibitors show the most reproducible drug sensitivity across at least two ORCESTRA PSets? Match cell lines and drugs across datasets, calculate drug-specific response correlations, and identify inhibitors with the most consistent sensitive and resistant models.

How consistent are Paclitaxel sensitivity rankings among shared breast cancer cell lines in GRAY, CCLE, and CTRPv2? Account for differences in the response endpoints by using within-dataset rankings, calculate pairwise correlations, and investigate the cell lines with the largest discrepancies.

Across ORCESTRA, identify drugs tested in at least three independent monotherapy PSets and rank them by the reproducibility of their cell-line sensitivity profiles. Match common drugs and cell lines, require at least 20 shared measured responses per dataset pair, calculate pairwise Spearman correlations, and identify the five most and least reproducible drugs.

How reproducible are drug sensitivity measurements between GDSC1 and GDSC2? For drugs measured in at least 30 shared cell lines, calculate the response correlation between the two releases, rank drugs by agreement, and inspect the raw dose-response curves for representative cell lines from the three most discordant drugs.

For Selumetinib, compare drug sensitivity across all eligible ORCESTRA monotherapy PSets. Harmonize drug identities and cell-line identifiers, calculate pairwise response correlations, and determine whether cross-dataset agreement differs between melanoma, lung, and other cancer cell lines.

Does Bortezomib sensitivity measured in CTRPv2 predict the degree of Bliss synergy observed for Bortezomib plus Vandetanib in NCI_ALMANAC? Match the common cell lines, integrate monotherapy response with combination synergy, calculate the association with and without tissue adjustment, and identify models with unexpectedly strong or weak combination effects.

Which genes are consistently associated with Gemcitabine sensitivity in both CTRPv2 and GDSC2? Perform tissue-adjusted gene-drug association analyses independently in each dataset, identify genes with significant associations (FDR < 0.05) in both datasets and concordant effect directions, and report the top five genes with their effect sizes, FDR values, and numbers of evaluable cell lines.
